Private Function Held(ws As Object, ByVal name As String) As Object
    Select Case name
    Case "Arcs"
        Set Held = ws.Arcs
    Case "Buttons"
        Set Held = ws.Buttons
    Case "CheckBoxes"
        Set Held = ws.CheckBoxes
    Case "DropDowns"
        Set Held = ws.DropDowns
    Case "Lines"
        Set Held = ws.Lines
    Case "ListBoxes"
        Set Held = ws.ListBoxes
    Case "OptionButtons"
        Set Held = ws.OptionButtons
    Case "Ovals"
        Set Held = ws.Ovals
    Case "Pictures"
        Set Held = ws.Pictures
    Case "Rectangles"
        Set Held = ws.Rectangles
    Case "TextBoxes"
        Set Held = ws.TextBoxes
    End Select
End Function

Public Function ReadOne(ws As Object, ByVal name As String, ByVal place As Long, ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim o As Object, v As Variant
    Set o = Held(ws, name)(place)
    On Error Resume Next
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        v = o.Name
    Case 1
        v = o.Visible
    Case 2
        v = o.Locked
    Case 3
        v = o.PrintObject
    Case 4
        v = o.Placement
    Case 5
        v = o.Enabled
    Case 6
        v = o.Text
    Case 7
        v = o.Caption
    Case 8
        v = o.Value
    Case 9
        v = o.LockedText
    Case 10
        v = o.OnAction
    Case 11
        v = o.Font.Bold
    Case 12
        v = o.Interior.ColorIndex
    Case 13
        v = o.Border.ColorIndex
    End Select
    If Err.Number Then
        ReadOne = "E" & Err.Number
    Else
        ReadOne = TypeName(v) & " " & CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Public Function Counted(ws As Object, ByVal name As String) As Long
    Counted = Held(ws, name).Count
End Function

Public Function ReadAll(ws As Object, ByVal name As String) As String
    Dim place As Long, which As Long, s As String
    For place = 1 To Counted(ws, name)
        For which = 0 To 13
            s = s & ReadOne(ws, name, place, which) & ";"
        Next
    Next
    ReadAll = Counted(ws, name) & ":" & s
End Function

Public Function Change(ws As Object, ByVal name As String, ByVal first As Boolean, ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim c As Object
    Set c = Held(ws, name)
    On Error Resume Next
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        If first Then
            c(1).Visible = False
        Else
            c.Visible = False
        End If
    Case 1
        If first Then
            c(1).Locked = False
        Else
            c.Locked = False
        End If
    Case 2
        If first Then
            c(1).PrintObject = False
        Else
            c.PrintObject = False
        End If
    Case 3
        If first Then
            c(1).Enabled = False
        Else
            c.Enabled = False
        End If
    Case 4
        If first Then
            c(1).Placement = 3
        Else
            c.Placement = 3
        End If
    Case 5
        If first Then
            c(1).Caption = "New"
        Else
            c.Caption = "New"
        End If
    Case 6
        If first Then
            c(1).Text = "New"
        Else
            c.Text = "New"
        End If
    Case 7
        If first Then
            c(1).LockedText = False
        Else
            c.LockedText = False
        End If
    Case 8
        If first Then
            c(1).Value = 1
        Else
            c.Value = 1
        End If
    Case 9
        If first Then
            c(1).OnAction = "M"
        Else
            c.OnAction = "M"
        End If
    Case 10
        If first Then
            c(1).Name = "Renamed"
        Else
            c.Name = "Renamed"
        End If
    Case 11
        If first Then
            c(1).Delete
        Else
            c.Delete
        End If
    Case 12
        If first Then
            c(1).Font.Bold = True
        Else
            c.Font.Bold = True
        End If
    Case 13
        If first Then
            c(1).Interior.ColorIndex = 6
        Else
            c.Interior.ColorIndex = 6
        End If
    Case 14
        If first Then
            c(1).Border.ColorIndex = 3
        Else
            c.Border.ColorIndex = 3
        End If
    Case 15
        If first Then
            c(1).Characters.Text = "Ch"
        Else
            c.Characters.Text = "Ch"
        End If
    End Select
    Change = "E" & Err.Number
End Function

Public Function ReadSaved(ByVal path As String, ByVal name As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path, 0)
    ReadSaved = ReadAll(wb.Worksheets(1), name)
    wb.Close False
End Function
